svg.title: The Sampling Abyss
svg.desc: A 48-cell mesh samples a height-field frequency almost at its Nyquist limit. Amplitude, warp, depth, and projection tilt exceed their normal controls; adjacent samples leap across the oscillating surface and stack into impossible walls. Native toolbar flow: nested path echoes → cross-sheared height fields, with a luminance-preserving monochrome palette.
